name: nDatalyze Corp.
summary: nDatalyze Corp. specializes in offering technology-driven solutions within the health sector. The company is actively developing an artificial intelligence-powered online application designed for individual mental wellness, and also engages in licensing its databases. Beyond its health-tech endeavors, nDatalyze also manufactures and distributes specialized equipment for essential oil extraction, utilizing both CO2 and alcohol-based methods. This machinery primarily caters to medical cannabis cultivators. The company, founded in 2018, is headquartered in Calgary, Canada. It underwent a name change in October 2021, transitioning from its former identity as MedXtractor Corp. to nDatalyze Corp.
